newsitems.title: Анонсировано дополнение "Ковены Умбрии" для Path of Exile - релиз 13 ноября"
newsitems.contents: Grinding Gear Games представила следующее крупное расширение для Path of Exile — «Covens of Umbra» («Ковены Умбрии»). Релиз запланирован на 13 ноября (по тихоокеанскому времени) на ПК и консолях.. Судя по короткому тизеру расширение будет посвящено новой могущественной угрозе. Подробности о сюжете, новых механиках, лигах и предметах разработчики пока не раскрывают. Полноценная презентация дополнения состоится 6 ноября на главной сцене ExileCon 2026. Прямая трансляция начнётся в 23:30 по московскому времени на Twitch-канале pathofexile и YouTube-канале игры. В рамках шоу разработчики расскажут о последних изменениях и покажут геймплей новой лиги.

newsitems.title: Path of Exile может получить второй золотой век: патч 3.30 обещает масштабную перестройку эндгейма
newsitems.contents: После нескольких непростых лет у Path of Exile появились поводы для оптимизма. Grinding Gear Games готовит крупное обновление, которое должно освежить устоявшиеся механики эндгейма, а в перспективе первая часть серии может получить больше внимания разработчиков. Ютубер Dreamcore считает, что игра приближается к новому расцвету, хотя многое будет зависеть от того, насколько удачными окажутся будущие обновления. С анонсом Path of Exile 2 развитие оригинала стало менее предсказуемым: релизы задерживались, крупные изменения Атласа выходили реже, а однажды игрокам пришлось почти год ждать новую лигу. Теперь ситуация, судя по заявлениям разработчиков, может измениться. В интервью на gamescom геймдиректор Джонатан Роджерс сообщил, что после завершения кампании Path of Exile 2 студия не планирует сокращать команду. Часть сотрудников займётся эндгеймом второй игры, а другие смогут перейти к работе над первой. Для Path of Exile это особенно важно: отдельная команда, сосредоточенная на оригинале,...

newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: We've just released the Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box, a new mystery box with no duplicate microtransactions! There are 56 microtransactions (including variations) that you can find in the Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box. Many of these microtransactions have a varying number of thematic variations, and you'll never receive a duplicate copy of a variation that you have already opened. For example, if you open one variant of a microtransaction, you may later receive another variant, but you'll never get a duplicate! From stunning Armour Sets and Portal Effects to an all-new Hideout and Otterly irresistible pets, there's plenty to discover! newsitems.title: Path of Exile 3.27 adopts Elden Ring's most grotesque mechanic for the free ARPG's first-ever sequel league
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents: Path of Exile 3.27 is 'Keepers of the Flame,' and it's the ARPG's first-ever sequel league. While public attention has certainly been more focused on PoE 2 since its early-access launch, there are a lot of reasons to care about its continuing predecessor. The first game is much more substantial, with a decade-plus of love and development from Grinding Gear Games honing it into one of the best RPGs on PC today - and you can play it for free. newsitems.title: Update on Server Issues, Compromised Accounts and Visual Flickering
newsitems.author: CommunityTeam_GGG
newsitems.contents: We'd like to provide an update on a few important things that have been happening in Path of Exile. Server Issues We've been very focused on improving DDoS protection for our servers. Unfortunately, some of the protective measures have blocked legitimate traffic, causing instances to unexpectedly close. We're working closely with our server providers to finish setting up protection and resolve these issues as soon as possible. Compromised Accounts There have recently been an increased amount of reports regarding players having their accounts compromised. We've looked into as many reports as we could, and will continue to do so, however we have found no evidence of any kind of security breach on our end. If you're not already, we strongly recommend using secure and unique passwords. If you login through Steam but previously used the Standalone client, your email and password is still a valid login method and you should ensure this password is secure and unique. newsitems.title: Mercenaries of Trarthus - Renown
newsitems.author: CommunityTeam_GGG
newsitems.contents: Since the Path of Exile: Secrets of the Atlas reveal last week we’ve continued to make changes to the Mercenaries league. One such change is the introduction of the Renown system. We’ve made a quick video for you to checkout but if you’d prefer to read it at your own pace we’ve included that too! As you defeat Mercenaries, you will gain Renown among the Trarthan arrivals to Wraeclast. Successfully defeating a Mercenary will push you up one rank of Renown, to a maximum of three, whereas either losing or backing out of a fight will cost you one rank. Backing out means that you speak to a Mercenary, view their gear and skills, then walk away and never fight that Mercenary. Returning to them in the same area will allow you to fight them without penalty. Only leaving and never returning to fight them will cost you Renown as they will spread the word of your cowardice amongst the other Trarthans. newsitems.title: Secrets of the Atlas Frequently Asked Questions
newsitems.author: CommunityTeam_GGG
newsitems.contents: In our recent GGG Live stream, Mark and Jonathan sat down for a Q&A with ZiggyD. In today's news post, we've provided answers to some of the most frequently asked questions that didn't make it into the livestream. Check them out! How does equipping Mercenaries with items work? Can any Mercenary be equipped with any item? Each Mercenary is associated with Attributes. Mercenaries will generate with gear that matches the Attributes they are associated with, and will only be able to be equipped with new Armour gear that matches their Attributes in the following way: For Mercenaries with a single Attribute, any Armour gear that requires that Attribute is valid. For Mercenaries with multiple Attributes, any Armour gear that requires an Attribute not associated with that Mercenary is invalid. As an example: A Strength Mercenary will be equippable with gear requiring just Strength, Strength + Dexterity or Strength + Intelligence.
